items.headline: How much context is actually enough for Claude Code to not go off script?
items.summary: Handed off what I thought was a solid PRD to Claude Code last week. Ended up going back and forth more than I expected just to get the output close to what I actually meant. Sonnet 4.6 is genuinely impressive right now but that's almost part of the problem. It runs so efficiently on lean context that you don't realize the edge cases you left out until something builds wrong. Too little and it fills the gaps itself, too much and you're bloating the spec in ways that create their own issues. PRDs
